title: ipomoea × multifida
intro: Ipomoea × multifida, commonly known as Hawaiian Blue morning glory, is a perennial vine native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, alleviating anxiety and insomnia, and lowering blood pressure due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea × multifida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit antimicrobial and anticonvulsant activities, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
